clusters.pick_reason: 1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that correctly handles HTTP Accept-header semantics: comma-separated media ranges, per-entry q-value parsing (rejecting entries with q=0), and type/subtype wildcard matching. 2046 fixes the same check with a plain acceptHeader.includes('application/json') substring test, which ignores q=0 exclusions and wildcard forms and is more prone to false-positive matches on substrings. 1996's approach is the more spec-correct, general fix for the identical validation logic both PRs touch.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215's buildWellKnownPath change is a strict superset of #2214's for that function (same `replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex, just extracted into a named `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper), and it additionally updates `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root-path check from '/' to '' to match — without this, the root-detection check stays mismatched against the normalized empty-string path and the redundant-fallback bug this PR targets remains unfixed. #2214's only piece not covered here is the parallel regex fix inside buildDiscoveryUrls, which is a smaller, separable follow-up that can be ported over using the helper #2215 already introduces.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the same trailing-slash-stripping block in buildWellKnownPath (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts, ~line 1035), so they collide on the identical lines and cannot both merge cleanly. #2214 replaces the single-slash `.endsWith('/')`/`.slice(0,-1)` check with `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` in two places (buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls). #2215 makes the same regex change in buildWellKnownPath only, via a new `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper, and additionally updates `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` so the fallback-avoidance logic stays consistent with the now-normalized empty-string root path.
